colour.legend: Light steps provide backgrounds. Middle steps separate objects and mark controls. Deep steps provide readable text and strong backgrounds.
contrast.explain: Ordinary text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background. Large text and the visible edges of controls need at least 3:1.
contrast.summary: Text {text}:1 · Muted text {muted}:1 · Link {link}:1 · all pass AA
surface.text: Useful information, with room to explain.
type.tuning: Some letter shapes change in larger text to make this typeface easier to read. Compare the same words with and without that adjustment.
type.scale-explain: The scale uses {narrow} up to a window of {from} px and {wide} from {to} px. The same styles grow smoothly between them.
type.scale-explain-step: The scale uses {narrow} in windows below {to} px and {wide} from there.
type.other-none: The main typeface covers every role; no complementary typeface is needed.
space.compact: The spacing is compact, keeping related information close together.
space.balanced: The spacing gives related information room while keeping it together.
space.loose: The spacing is generous, giving sections and objects more room.
frame.on: A {width} px frame outlines buttons and cards.
frame.off: Buttons and cards have no added frame.
shape.card.text: Cards bring one idea and its next step together.
shape.panel.text: A layer that lies over the page.
shadow.on: Shadows separate objects from what lies beneath them. Their depth stays consistent across the design.
shadow.off: Shadows are off. Changes of background and thin rules separate the layers.
details.system-font: System or installed typefaces use the reader’s own installation and its licence.
details.licence: {name} — SIL Open Font License 1.1. The publisher’s licence is included below.
comment.storage: Comments cannot be stored in this browser. Send or save them before closing this document.
comment.saved: Comments are saved in this browser.
comment.draft: Your draft is saved as you type.
comment.clear-confirm: Clear all comments and your saved draft?
comment.copy-failed: Copy is unavailable here. Save the text file instead.
comment.attach: Your comments are too long for a mail link. Save the file and attach it to the message.
comment.mail-note: Please see the attached comments file.
comment.subject: {client} — {document} — comments
comment.no-email: No contact email was supplied. Save or copy your comments.
comment.email-help: Comments stay here after you send them. Clear them only when you are ready.
start.title: A design to build on
start.lead: The colours, type and components that bring the design together.
colour-scale.title: The colour scale
colour-scale.lead: The brand colours have a job. Their lighter and deeper shades support that job throughout the site.
colour-together.title: The colours together
colour-together.lead: These examples show text and controls on the backgrounds they will use.
main-typeface.title: The main typeface
main-typeface.lead: One family gives the text a consistent voice.
type-scale.title: The type scale
type-scale.lead: Headings make the structure clear. Their sizes adapt to the available window.
other-typefaces.title: Complementary typefaces
other-typefaces.lead: Other families have specific jobs, rather than competing with the main text.
typography-use.title: Typography in use
typography-use.lead: A short article shows how the text works when people read it.
space.title: Space
space.lead: Spacing groups related information and gives each section a clear beginning.
corners.title: Corners and frame
corners.lead: Buttons, fields and cards share a consistent shape.
shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.lead: Depth helps people see which layer an object belongs to.
header.title: Header
header.lead: The identity, navigation and search help people find their way.
footer.title: Footer
footer.lead: The end of a page keeps useful links and contact information in reach.
page.title: The page
page.lead: Scroll inside this example to see the header, content and footer work together.
breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.lead: A trail at the top of a page shows where it lies in the site, and the way back up.
breadcrumbs.first-band: The trail stands at the top of the page's first section, above its heading.
breadcrumbs.own-band: The trail stands in a thin band of its own, directly under the header.
breadcrumbs.off: This design shows no trail. A page's place in the site comes from the menu alone.
opening.title: Opening a page
opening.lead: An opening introduces the subject and offers a useful next step.
sections.title: Sections
sections.lead: Bands organise a page. Pictures, calls to action and figures give each section a purpose.
text.title: Text
text.lead: Readable text can include navigation, quotations, notices, questions and tables.
buttons.title: Buttons and links
buttons.lead: Actions look consistent on light and dark backgrounds. Try the controls or open the states below.
cards.title: Cards
cards.lead: Cards group a picture, a heading and the information needed to choose a next step.
media.title: Pictures and video
media.lead: Pictures keep their captions. Video has native controls. External media stays offline in this document.
finding.title: Finding content
finding.lead: People can search, filter and move through lists without losing the context.
forms.title: Forms and consent
forms.lead: Labels and clear errors guide input. Privacy choices can be opened and changed.
details.title: Details
details.lead: These reference values are here for the people implementing the design. Open only what you need.
comments.title: Comments
comments.lead: Review your comments and send them as plain text. No account or server is needed.
colour.primary.job: The main identity and strongest backgrounds.
colour.secondary.job: A supporting colour for accents and a separate tint.
colour.tertiary.job: An additional tint for grouping content.
role.heading: headings
role.label: labels
type.label: Label
shadow.box.job: Separates a card from its background.
shadow.box-lifted.job: Shows a card responding to interaction.
shadow.header.job: Keeps navigation above the scrolling page.
shadow.header-panel.job: Keeps navigation above its open menu.
shadow.panel.job: Separates a menu or dialog from the page.
shadow.page.job: Marks the edge as the footer is revealed.
specimen.reading-area: Reading Area and Table of Contents
